name: executor-config-visibility
title: 执行器配置可见性与终态错误可观测
description: 修复 2026-09-03 两条 cardx 会话暴露的三项缺陷：① workloom 会话上下文注入生效中的执行器画像（kind → model/effort/工具面 + 配置来源层），消除"看不到全局配置层只能猜"；② 执行器终态 stopReason=error 时，从子会话记录提取真实 turn 错误，写进 task.json dispatches[].error（替代泛化的 "the executor failed before it finished"）；③ workloom_execute 工具描述补充覆盖语义警示：model/effort 参数覆盖三层配置，仅用户明确要求时传递。根因证据：session-2fe7e677（task.json override 留痕被当判例 + 全局配置层不可见 → 错误 force 覆盖全局配置）、session-eb22f744（裸 model id → UNKNOWN_MODEL ×3，终态错误不可见导致误诊重试）。
creator: northwang-lucky

grilling.summary: Design-tree grilling converged in one round; user confirmed all 8 frontier decisions as recommended. Settled: (Q1) config-source provenance as top-level fields subagentProfilesSource/subagentsSource (single-key single-source, no per-entry tagging); (Q2) function-factory layer owns provenance when subagent_profiles appears in the factory doc, else inherits lower layer; (Q3) Executor profiles section lists all 4 kinds, unconfigured marked 'inherits parent session model', source shown as 'global/project/local config (whenMain match | fallback entry | legacy subagents)', tools truncated with count, 'main model unknown; whenMain entries skipped' when unavailable; (Q4) both sections placed right after Active task line, Last dispatch line = 'Last dispatch: <kind> <status> at <time> (child <id>) — <one-line error>', shown for completed too, only latest, omitted when none; (Q5) error extraction via global session/event listener capturing latest turn/end error for registered childIds into an in-process registry consumed at settle (no zstd/storage coupling); (Q6) dispatches[].error fully replaced with the real one-line error (cap 200 chars), generic wording only as extraction-failure fallback; (Q7) override-warning wording appended to PARAM_DESCRIPTIONS.model/effort in core/surface.ts (single source, both adapters), force/reason text untouched; (Q8) post-deploy smoke covers profile-section visibility plus a deliberate bad provider/model dispatch to confirm the real error lands in task.json. Engineering defaults declared: session/event listener consumes only turn/end for registered childIds; completed/aborted/max-tokens/refusal wording unchanged; sibling task 09-03-unify-workloom-alignment file surface assumed non-overlapping, re-verify on conflict.
